mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, price, stock, image_url, tag, created_at, updated_at FROM product WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE tag = #{tag}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, description, price, stock, image_url, tag, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{imageUrl}, #{tag}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
